<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 121

Mirage dragons are masters of illusion magic and use their powers to deceive others and further their own agendas. In addition to their magical prowess, mirage dragons possess a number of additional features to help them on hunts or mislead attackers, such as their camouflaging scales and a hallucinatory breath that can confound multiple foes at once. Mirage dragons are vain and egotistical figures. They ultimately care more about themselves than others.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Mirage Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2951) (Creature 13), [Ancient Mirage Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2952) (Creature 18), [Young Mirage Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2950) (Creature 9)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Dijansi</title>

The village of New Lipror in southern Jalmeray is home to a secret: it doesn't exist. The mirage dragon Dijansi initially created the illusory village as a form of entertainment. Eventually, the village drew curious travelers, whom Dijansi convinced to maintain the village's secret and to give her their treasures and adoration. Dijansi now uses the village to draw more patrons to satisfy her desire for riches and attention.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Mirage Dragon Lairs</title>

A mirage dragon's lair is filled with the typical treasures one would expect from a dragon. Unlike the hoards of other dragons, a mirage dragon takes care to polish every coin, gem, and precious metal to a mirror shine. These reflective items are placed methodically throughout the lair, allowing the dragon to see themself from all angles at any time. In addition to the typical riches, mirage dragons also keep mirrors in their hoards to better scratch their narcissistic itches. Mirage dragons tend to keep lairs in natural environments, which are better suited for their camouflage. These lairs are generally near lakes and other large bodies of water that serve as an additional natural mirror for the dragon.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Mirage Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Mirage dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Mirage Dragon
 Arcane Prepared Spells DC 27, attack +20; **4th** [_confusion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1471), [_vision of death_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1742); **3rd** [_disguise magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1491), [_enthrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1516), [_hypnotize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1564); **2nd** [_embed message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1511), [_revealing light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1653), [_see the unseen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1663); **1st** [_item facade_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1579), [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631), [_ventriloquism_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1740); **Cantrips (4th)** [_daze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1482), [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1585), [_prestidigitation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1639), [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1646) 

### Adult Mirage Dragon
 **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 35, attack +27; As young mirage dragon, plus **6th** [_mislead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1605), [_phantasmal calamity_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1630); **5th** [_false vision_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1522), [_sending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1665), [_telekinetic haul_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1716); **4th** [_vapor form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738); **Cantrips (6th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _light_, _prestidigitation_, _read aura_ 

### Ancient Mirage Dragon
 **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 43, attack +35; As adult mirage dragon, plus **8th** [_disappearance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1490), [_hallucination_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1551), [_hidden mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1556); **7th** [_contingency_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1472), [_mask of terror_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1595), [_project image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1640); **6th** [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727); **Cantrips (8th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _light_, _prestidigitation_, _read aura_
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
